notes:
ARKhives 8.19.11

- Keep Video Lessons and Documents in one consistent workspace. Closing the final notebook returns to the unified Study Library rather than the legacy library.
- Rebuild the lesson canvas safely when the same source is reopened, preserving access to navigation and notebook tools.
- Route source-type tabs, recovered notebooks and Word source links through the same navigation flow. Cancel delayed navigation after account or destination changes.
- Move bulk source organization and notebook recovery into a focused library dialog. Preserve revision checks, source files and linked notes.
- Remove the extra navigation gutter in narrow desktop windows.
- Eliminate repeated construction of the syllabus text normalizer. A read-only profile of the same local bank reduced board-analysis time from 42.69 seconds to 4.73 seconds.
- Preserve question banks, personal progress, notebooks, the original ARKhives branding and the independent mobile interface.

Validation covers same-source reopening, final-notebook closure, both source-type tab paths, revision-guarded organization, independent scrolling, native ONLYOFFICE DOCX saves and AI preview insertion, Word source links, desktop layouts and native/mobile engine parity. AI provider responses in browser acceptance are synthetic; live AI service availability is a separate check.
